name: spine-register
description: Global registration of per-segment submaps into ONE gauge (STO-SCN-098). A SIM(3) pose graph over the spine segments (STO-SCN-097): nodes = per-segment SfM gauges, edges = shared boundary cameras (adjacent seams share camera identities; loop-closure edges from revisit correspondences). Per-edge relative similarity reuses the canonical gauge_align (Umeyama + consensus trimming + rotation augmentation for near-collinear walking-path overlaps, STO-SCN-090). Fixes the reference segment = identity, initialises along a spanning tree, then Gauss-Seidel relaxation distributes drift (and loop-closure residual around cycles) until every camera sits in one drift-corrected gauge. Emits per-segment gauges, per-seam residuals (the scale-free tolerance gate, T-001), and globally consistent per-camera poses for fusion (STO-SCN-099). Pure-numpy; runs locally over the per-segment solves. Consumes a per-segment solve manifest; lives under the spine.

rel_tol.note: max seam residual as a fraction of scene spread for within_tol (scale-free gate)
